setup.name: setup-01-python
setup.cmd: python -c "import urllib.request as u; B='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/munimtechnologies/interface-heat-transport/main/'; [u.urlretrieve(B + p, '/work/' + p) for p in ('requirements-anh.txt', 'tbc_transport.py', 'tbc_phonons.py', 'tbc_bte.py', 'tbc_anh.py')]"

run_steps.name: run-01-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile tbc_diag.py test_tbc_diag.py fetch_npz.py tbc_bte.py tbc_anh.py tbc_transport.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; grep -h 'VERSION = ' *.py | tee /out/versions.txt; sha256sum *.py | tee /out/sha256.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-02-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_tbc_diag > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-03-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python fetch_npz.py /tmp/npz > /out/fetch.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fetch.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-04-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 python tbc_diag.py --npz-dir /tmp/npz --out /out > /out/stdout-diag.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/stdout-diag.txt; exit $rc
